One possibility worth examining is that you may be more guarded than you realize when relationships get close. This could be connected to your tendency to hold and protect what matters, which is a quality that shows up in your Baseline as your Sun core expression. It's possible that this protective instinct is triggered when relationships get close, causing you to pull away to maintain a sense of safety and control.

It may be worth looking into whether this dynamic is related to your reflex to guard what you love, which is another quality that appears in your Baseline as your Moon inner response. This reflex might be causing you to create distance in relationships when they start to feel too close or intense.

One way to see this is that being in a close relationship might make you feel like you're losing control or exposing yourself to potential hurt. This could be a recurring dynamic that plays out in different relationships, leading you to pull away and maintain a sense of emotional distance.

What does it mean to you when you say that you find a reason to pull away when relationships get close?
